results.title: The Michael C. Jordan Theory
results.overview: Michael C. Jordan suspects Instagram is listening into his conversations. So, he takes matters into his own hands to make his algorithm respect him.

results.title: Every Side of the Bed
results.original_title: Todos los lados de la cama
results.overview: After decades without seeing each other, Javier and Carlota are furious when they discover that their children are planning to get married. Who at their age has a heteronormative and exclusive relationship in 2025 with all they have left to experience? Have they been taught nothing as parents?

results.title: We'll Still Be Here
results.overview: Two cousins reunite after a long time apart- one who has fallen into a spiral of drug use, and one who has become a vampire.

results.title: Jasmine That Blooms in Autumn
results.overview: Love blossoms secretly between two old women at an elderly care home while the specter of patriarchy looms large overhead.

results.title: Honeymoon
results.overview: February 23, 2022, a small town near Kyiv. Taras (35) and Olia (32) spend the first night in their new apartment. At dawn, they wake up from the explosions. They fail to leave the town on time, meanwhile, the Russian troops arrange headquarters in their building. The couple finds themselves trapped in their flat with no electricity, water, and mobile connection. For the next 5 days, Taras and Olia will explore the black abyss of real intimacy between two people and face crucial existential questions in mortal danger.

results.title: Hallo Betty
results.overview: In 1956, advertising copywriter Emmi Creola invents the fictional character Betty Bossi, who quickly becomes a Swiss culinary icon. But as her creation rises to fame, Emmi finds herself caught between growing professional expectations and her own personal struggles — a tension that threatens to consume her.

results.title: Soulmates
results.overview: A carefree rickshaw driver’s life changes when a don targets him and a European tourist, Isa, joins him to test her fiancé’s love. As they journey through Rajasthan’s deserts, havelis, and forts, their bond deepens—but soulmates don’t always stay together. A cross-cultural romance filled with adventure, magic, and longing.

results.title: Dark Moon
results.overview: Mara leaves her house on the beach after a night of partying. Something is not right, an evil has been unleashed.

results.title: Crickets, It's Your Turn
results.overview: Crickets, It’s Your Turn is a darkly absurd feminist parable in which a young photographer’s private theatre of imagination begins to invade reality. Merey enters a mountain house governed by hierarchy, male solidarity and the logic of the strongest. She follows another logic: beauty, play and creation. Through white-room tableaux, grotesque humour and deliberate ruptures between realism and theatre, an ordinary gathering becomes a study of collective complicity. The danger comes not from a single monster, but from reasonable men who protect one another until violence becomes ceremony.

results.title: Steven Spielberg, the “New Hollywood” Prodigy
results.overview: A new light on American filmmaker Steven Spielberg, Hollywood’s greatest director, offering a unique perspective on his work and digging into his personal influences.

results.title: The One
results.overview: At 17 years old, as the only hearing member in her hearing-impaired family, the girl has long navigated between her family's silent world and the outside world of sound, growing accustomed to serving as both bridge and interpreter. Their love and dependence entwine her like creeping vines, yet within her heart rages a fierce flame of longing for a broader world. An unexpected upheaval forces Yu Yan to confront the dilemma between pursuing her dreams and protecting her family. Through the crucible of growing pains, she begins to carve her own path while seeking a melody she can share with those she loves.

results.title: Priscilla, Queen of the Desert: The Musical
results.overview: This musical follows an incredibly colorful troupe – three drag queens who embark on a hilarious and moving journey in a pink bus they have named "Priscilla" to perform a drag show at the end of the world.  It's a story about a father's love for his son, uncompromised friendship, and a celebration of individual freedom and self-fulfillment.  Accompanied by a dreamy soundtrack of the greatest and most timeless pop and disco hits, with spectacular costumes and a message of openness, acceptance, and compassion.

results.title: Un corto de zombies
results.overview: Escaping a zombie horde, a girl enters an empty house to seek shelter, not knowing what she will find there.

results.title: Kabaddi
results.overview: Five friends escape to a nearby island for a long weekend, where clashes over feminism, inclusive language, ambition, and purpose force them to reevaluate their bonds.

results.title: A Winnie-the-Pooh Christmas
results.overview: Pooh and friends wake up to missing Christmas presents and set off on a snowy adventure through Hundred Acre Wood, encountering magical creatures and learning that friendship is the best gift.

results.title: Canicas
results.overview: A distraught teen attempts to track down her recently-deceased father’s missing cat, only to unearth a devastating family secret in the process.

results.title: Legends of the Highway
results.overview: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950's and 60's led by renowned painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton.

results.title: Dark Corner
results.overview: John is chased by a killer, without knowing who will end up winning.
